limitations: Both original games and match points/wins reproduced in par_losses; only final game wins reproducible from mechanism JSON output.
Neither diagnostic output emits actual total step count; mechanism JSON also omits endpoint points/per-match winner.
Mechanism own half includes diagonal x+y=23, par_losses own half excludes it; do not treat those own-half counts as directly identical.
Mechanism damages and deaths are reconstruction, not independently validated causal attribution.

normalization.information_ratios: unknown point-tile steps divided by true own-half point-tile steps; mechanism own-half includes diagonal
normalization.free_untargeted_share: untargeted free known own-half tile steps divided by all free known own-half tile steps
normalization.low_energy_point_unit_share: point-tile unit steps below sap-cost energy divided by point-tile unit steps
normalization.stacked_point_unit_share: unit steps in stacks on point tiles divided by point-tile unit steps
normalization.opponent_information_classification: not measured; not represented as zero
